Session.description: Opaque server-side session; development cookie has a separate name.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
Csrf.description: ASP.NET antiforgery request token paired with the antiforgery cookie.

personId.description: Optional existing person from an authorized same-client relationship; never a global person search. Names update this contact declaration, not the canonical person or another contact.

FlagWrite.description: Declined consent cannot create or update sensitive detail. Each explicit visibility grant requires an active same-client relationship containing this person and functional agency wording. API validates membership and dates.

candidateRelationshipId.description: The captured candidate relationship, for unambiguous internal agency context; never infer it from the first account relationship.

MatchReview.description: Internal comparison evidence pinned at capture. submissionId and embedded submission.id agree; ruleVersionId and rule.id agree. quoteId is absent until linked to an actual quote. No candidate data belongs in a submission-side decline.

AgencyWrite.description: Incomplete typed draft, maximum UTF-8 JSON body 65536 bytes. Omit missing fields; reject null/unknown keys. Declarations never set verification or activation status.

Invitation.description: Staging has no token, expiry or delivery job. Issuance expires exactly 14 real-time days later. State is acceptance validity, not delivery. Resend revokes the predecessor and creates a fresh invitation.

MarketingConsent.description: Declared channel consent; not-asked is distinct from withheld. Recording audit actor/time are server-owned.

PartyMutationReceipt.description: Safe identity-only command receipt. The original strong ETag is returned in the header; fetch current details through an authorized GET.

AgencyKpis.description: brokerUsers counts retained agency-scoped identities, including inactive users; invitedUsers counts the invited subset including staged identities. openActions sums pending state, terms and permission requests; dueFollowUps separately counts immutable recorded obligations with DueOn on or before asOfDate in London, not open or completed workflow tasks. KPI totals cover all agencies independently of directory filters.
